relations.statement: For a finite strict poset P and A : Fin n -> M with A_x A_y = A_y A_x for spacelike x,y, adjacent spacelike swaps leave orderedProd A unchanged.
relations.hypotheses: P : FiniteStrictPoset n; hcomm: commutation on all spacelike pairs

relations.statement: Any chain of adjacent spacelike swaps (SpacelikeSwapChain) leaves orderedProd A unchanged.

lemmas.statement: Swap invariance lifts to chains of adjacent spacelike swaps.

near_misses.claim: Any two linear extensions of an arbitrary finite strict poset are connected by adjacent spacelike swaps.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Connectivity of linear extensions by adjacent spacelike swaps is not established in Lean for arbitrary posets; only C2 is exhibited.

near_misses.claim: The five linear extensions of the N poset have equal ordered products.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Their mutual connectivity by adjacent spacelike swaps is not stated, so equality is not grounded.

open_obligations: Prove in Lean that any two linear extensions of an arbitrary finite strict poset are connected by a chain of adjacent spacelike swaps.
State and prove connectivity for the five linear extensions of the N poset, then derive equality of ordered products.
Relation to Epstein-Glaser is an analogy only; no finite counterpart of distribution extension or UV content is grounded.
